newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Subdued Australian bond yields creep lower.
newsitem.headline: Subdued Australian bond yields creep lower.

text.p: *Australian bonds yield crept lower during an extremely dull morning session with the absence of major data leaving the market desperate for interest.
*Result of 2020 indexed bond tender due 2.00 p.m. (0400 GMT)
Australian bond yields crept lower during an extremely dull morning session with the absence of major data leaving the market desperate for interest.

A rebound in U.S. Treasuries on Wednesday helped to give the local market a firmer footing after the corrective sell-off over past two sessions, but turnover was light with under 5,000 lots recorded on the 10-year bond futures contract.

Traders said hopes of a further easing in monetary policy also helped to underpin the market, although expectations are that such a move will not occur until after the Reserve Bank board meeting on July 1 and the FOMC on July 1/2.

The local market reversed its initial widening bias to the to U.S. and extended its outperformance against Canada. Canadian debt fell sharply on Wednesday on the back of a sharp drop in the Canadian dollar. The local yield curve continued its recent flattening trend.
